adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Neonatal Bartter physiology plus congenital sensorineural deafness and BSND loss identify Bartter type IV from barttin-dependent ClC-K dysfunction shared by kidney and inner ear.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: NKCC2 and ROMK cause other Bartter types without the characteristic deafness; isolated ClC-Kb and NCC defects do not match BSND-associated dual-organ disease.
